limitations: Five repeated group splits overlap; their test observations are not independent.
Same 400 public-validation turns, not a new external dataset or verified unseen-speaker test.
Parakeet re-decodes prefixes, not a streaming state machine; 300ms lag is simulated.
Shuffling changes semantic/speaker information as well as paralinguistics; not an emotion intervention.
Normalized zero audio may be out of distribution; controls are diagnostics.
Policy budgets fit on dev; actual test cutoffs are unconstrained and reported.
No RL or emotion-specific human labels.
